updates.text: Lucas worked both padded days with no communicated restriction. His set landmark held against rookie rushers and Andre Branch beat him around the edge once. The foot remains a performance-staff review item, not a newly diagnosed limit.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Cornelius Lucas is a rookie tackle who has been active for {{2014.regular.games:words}} regular-season games, with {{2014.regular.special_teams_snaps}} snaps on special teams. He is a very large tackle with long arms and enough strength for the position. His set is still raw, and he falls short on bend, foot speed and change of direction; in camp his set landmark held against the rookie rushers, though Andre Branch beat him around the edge once.

transactions.text: Signed a three-year contract with Jacksonville as an undrafted rookie
